title: ParaSwap Token
description: A token supported by the ParaSwap/Velora DEX aggregator, returned from the /tokens endpoint.

address.description: Token contract address. ETH is represented as 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for the token.

img.description: URL for the token logo image.

network.description: Blockchain network ID the token is on.

newToken.description: True if this is a newly listed token.

connectors.description: List of connector token addresses used in routing.

tokenType.description: Classification of the token standard or protocol.
